Indian Badminton Players Advance at China Masters

Indian badminton players Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty have advanced to the semifinals of the China Masters tournament. They defeated the Popov brothers in a match that required a rally to overcome. In other matches, Kidambi Srikanth's run in the tournament has concluded with a quarterfinal exit. Tanvi Sharma has progressed to the Round of 16. Lakshya Sen has been eliminated from the competition.
